div.div: فَحْوَةٌ i. q. شَهْدَةٌ [A portion of honey; or a honey-comb; or a portion of a honey-comb]. (K, TA. [It is added in the latter that it is as though it were formed by transposition from فَوْحَة; which I do not find in this sense in any lexicon.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
